correctness.rationale: After endpoint-phase normalization, exact expansion gives E=5+4F. Four corner values of F are explicit sums of two squares after tangent half-angle substitution. Their certificate vectors satisfy z1·z4-z2·z3=-4DB; Cauchy--Schwarz yields sqrt(p1p4)+sqrt(p2p3)>=2|B|, and a half-angle AM-GM decomposition then gives F>=0 globally. Continuity covers tangent poles. The sixth-root witness has all five sidelobes of modulus one, so the bound is sharp.
